title: 第十一章 诗
slug: 民国我包国维黄埔一期
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

校长送的笔格外好使，比自己之前那支坏了的要好很多。

虽然内容都能记在脑子里，但有时候也要写些东西，没有好笔可不行。

赢来了这支钢笔，就不用再去买了，也算解决了一桩紧要事。

半天上课，半天军训，晚上的时间，没特别事情的话基本都是自己的，可以做一些自个的事。

包国维早早回到了宿舍，拿了毛巾先去澡堂冲洗一下，这广东的天气确实有些炎热还潮湿，稍微动弹一下身上就黏糊，还好这边不缺水，大把的水，可以天天冲洗。

再往前几百年，广东那可是犯人的流放之地。现在的话，广州的经济发展倒是非常不错。

冲凉之后整个人都清爽了，看到宿舍一个室友在写写画画，时不时的就在写点东西。

“他写什么呢？”

“写诗呢，他这个人经常写诗。”

“写诗？”包国维瞬间也有了这个想法，他没写过诗，但他是穿越来的啊，现在新文化盛行，有着记忆能力在，大把的白话诗自己都记得。

自1919五四之后，这白话诗白话文渐渐开始也成了主流。

包国维也拿出纸笔来准备写点东西，赚取点稿费。民国，他晓得现在的文化人赚钱不少，那些个写文章的，可能一篇文章就能抵普通人一月的工钱。

脑子想着该写点啥。

目前流行的是新文化，白话诗和白话文。就决定写白话诗了。诗的字数少，更加方便。

回忆了下两篇脍炙人口的诗篇，当即开始往纸上写。校长奖励的钢笔好使的很。

“国维，这就是校长给的那支钢笔吧。你这就用上了，要是我，那得好好

卑鄙是卑鄙者的通行证，高尚是高尚者的墓志铭。

这，这，好诗啊。”

虽说军校，那都是能文能武的，有文化考试成绩，怎么说也要个中学水准才能入学。就算不会写诗，但品鉴不成问题。

只这开篇第一句，就学的包国维写的是极好的。

等包国维写完之后，好几个在宿舍的舍友都过来看看。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The pen given by the principal works exceptionally well, much better than the broken one I had before.

Although the content can be remembered in my mind, sometimes I have to write something, and it is impossible without a good pen.

After winning this pen, I no longer have to buy it, and it can be regarded as solving an urgent matter.

Half a day of class, half a day of military training, and the evening time is basically your own unless you have something special to do, and you can do some personal things.

Bao Guowei returned to the dormitory early, took a towel and went to the bathhouse to rinse first. The weather in Guangdong was indeed hot and humid, and he would feel sticky even if he moved a little. Fortunately, there was no shortage of water here, and there was plenty of water, so he could rinse it every day.

A few hundred years ago, Guangdong was a place of exile for prisoners.Now, Guangzhou's economic development is very good.

After taking a shower, I felt refreshed. I saw a roommate in the dormitory writing and drawing, writing something from time to time.

"What did he write?"

"Writing poetry, he often writes poetry."

"Write poetry?" Bao Guowei also had this idea in an instant. He has never written poetry, but he has traveled through time. Now that the new culture is prevalent, he has the ability to remember, and he can remember a lot of vernacular poems.

Since the May Fourth Movement in 1919, this vernacular poetry has gradually become the mainstream.

Bao Guowei also took out a pen and paper to write something to earn some royalties.During the Republic of China, he knew that today's intellectuals made a lot of money. For those who wrote articles, one article might be worth an average person's monthly salary.

I was thinking about what to write.

What is currently popular is New Culture, vernacular poetry and vernacular prose.I decided to write vernacular poetry.The poem has fewer words and is more convenient.

I recalled two popular poems and immediately started writing them on paper.The pen awarded by the principal is very useful.

"Guowei, this is the pen given by the principal. You can use it now. If it were me, I would have to use it carefully."

Despicability is the passport of the despicable, and nobility is the epitaph of the noble.

This, this, is such a poem."

Although military academies are for those who are capable of both literary and military skills and have cultural test scores, they must be at the middle school level before they can enroll.Even if you don’t know how to write poetry, your appreciation of poetry is not a problem.

This first sentence alone, written by Bao Guowei who was a student, is excellent.

After Bao Guowei finished writing, several roommates in the dormitory came over to take a look.
